items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff spotted cruising Monaco in a $10million Mercedes Unicorn
detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫在摩纳哥驾驶一辆价值1000万美元的梅赛德斯独角兽
托托·沃尔夫被拍到在摩纳哥街头驾驶一辆超罕见的1000万美元梅赛德斯-奔驰CLK GTR
赛车文化不仅仅在赛道上。车手的生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
管理一级方程式锦标赛的巨大压力需要找到在比赛周末之间放松的方法。对于梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫来说，在美国大奖赛之前放松似乎包括驾驶这辆罕见的、最昂贵、最激进的公路车之一，在赌场广场上悠闲地驾驶
就在一场艰苦、潮湿的新加坡大奖赛后的几天，这位亿万富翁赛车运动执行官被Instagram账号@monaco_luxurystyle拍摄到在公国阳光明媚的街道上驾驶一辆银色的梅赛德斯-奔驰CLK GTR。
即使在摩纳哥，一个布加迪和法拉利泛滥的城市，CLK GTR也能完全阻止交通。
这辆车是一种"认证特殊车"——一种专为满足FIA规定而建造的合法街道车，以便将其赛车版本进入1997年FIA GT锦标赛。为了合法地在赛道上竞争，梅赛德斯-奔驰不得不为公众客户生产一小批汽车。结果是，一辆碳纤维单体壳怪物，装备了一台中置的6.9升自然吸气AMG V12发动机。
这款CLK GTR拥有惊人的604马力，572磅英尺的扭矩，基本上是一款穿着皮革座椅和空调的勒芒式耐力赛车。
在开阔的道路上发现CLK GTR是一件极其罕见的事件。梅赛德斯-奔驰总共只生产了28辆：两个原型车，20辆双门轿跑车和六辆敞篷车。
由于其极端的稀缺性和在汽车纯粹主义者中的神话般地位，过去十年中，该车辆的价值已经飙升。当它在1997年首次亮相时，被吉尼斯世界纪录认证为世界上最昂贵的量产车，售价约为150万美元。
如今，这些数字已经呈指数级增长。六款敞篷车之一最近在RM Sotheby's拍卖中以令人震惊的1023.5万美元的价格售出，而双门轿跑车在私下里通常能卖出八位数的估值。
当新秀车手奇米·安东内利在欧洲秋季的秋风中为他在奥斯汀2026年世界车手锦标赛的参赛机会做准备时，他的老板显然正在驾驶梅赛德斯历史的巅峰之作享受着秋天的美景。
detailEn: Toto Wolff spotted cruising Monaco in a $10million Mercedes Unicorn
Toto Wolff was spotted driving an ultra-rare, $10million Mercedes-Benz CLK GTR through the streets of Monaco
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Managing the immense pressure of a Formula 1 championship battle requires finding ways to disconnect between race weekends. For Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff, unwinding ahead of the United States Grand Prix apparently involves taking one of the rarest, most expensive, and most aggressive road cars ever built for a casual drive through Casino Square.

Just days after a gruelling, humidity-soaked Singapore Grand Prix, the billionaire motorsport executive was filmed by the Instagram account @monaco_luxurystyle navigating the sun-drenched streets of the Principality in a silver Mercedes-Benz CLK GTR.
Even in Monaco, a city overflowing with Bugattis and Ferraris, the CLK GTR completely stops traffic.

The vehicle is a "homologation special" - a street-legal car built specifically to satisfy the FIA regulations required to enter the racing version in the 1997 FIA GT Championship. To legally compete on the track, Mercedes-Benz had to produce a small batch of cars for public customers. The result was a carbon-fibrecarbon fibreum monocoque monster housing a mid-mounted 6.9-litre naturally aspirated AMG V12 engine.
Producing a staggering 604 horsepower and 572 pound-feet of torque, the road-going CLK GTR was essentially a Le Mans-style endurance racer dressed up with leather seats and air conditioning.
Spotting a CLK GTR on the open road is an incredibly rare event. Mercedes-Benz only ever built 28 examples in total: two prototypes, 20 coupes, and six roadsters.

Because of that extreme scarcity and its mythical status among automotive purists, the vehicle's value has skyrocketed over the last decade. When it debuted in 1997, it was certified by Guinness as the world's most expensive production vehicle with a price tag of roughly $1.5million.

Today, those figures have multiplied exponentially. One of the six roadster variants was recently sold at an RM Sotheby's auction for a jaw-dropping $10,235,000, and the coupes routinely command massive eight-figure valuations behind closed doors.

While rookie sensation Kimi Antonelli preps for his shot at the 2026 World Drivers' Championship in Austin, his boss is clearly enjoying the European autumn behind the wheel of the ultimate piece of Mercedes history.

items.originalTitle: Classic F1 turns Port of Nice into street circuit for Bradley Cooper's "Ocean's" Prequel
detailZh: 经典一级方程式赛车将尼斯港口变成布拉德利·库珀《海洋》前传的街道赛道
画面显示复古赛车在水面旁的干草堆轨道上挑战
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
经典一级方程式赛车正在尼斯港口周围竞速，Instagram上流传的这段视频是目前为止最清晰的一次，展示了布拉德利·库珀的《海洋》前传计划如何再次将赛车运动搬上银幕。正如你所见，这个工作港口已经被改造成了一个20世纪60年代初的欧洲公路赛道。如果你想要证明这部电影对赛车是认真的，这就是证据。
画面从一辆配备起重机的日产GT-R摄像机车辆开始，它位于几辆复古开放式赛车前方，这些赛车并排行驶在水边。制作临时结构和防护屏障沿着赛道两侧排列。领头的赛车是深红色带有白色条纹，其尾部似乎粘着一个像布拉汉姆F1赛车的东西，后面跟着几辆其他的赛车。
随着车队前进，摄像机横扫港口设施。港口管理局大楼，上面有“Service Plaisance Yachting”的标志，与电影拖车和工作人员区域并排而立。引导车辆绕过该区域的屏障和赛车都穿着来自马蒂尼、BP和壳牌等品牌的复古标志。
最佳时刻是发夹弯。赛车挤过一条由干草堆围成的狭窄弯道，正好在水面边缘，红色赛车在蓝色赛车挤占其变速箱后被超越。
这个项目是一部未命名的，作为1962年摩纳哥大奖赛的序曲，描绘了丹尼·奥申的父母在比赛周末参与抢劫。由于与电影方向的分歧，布拉德利·库珀在2026年3月接替李·艾萨克·乔恩的职务，负责写作、导演和表演。制作地点包括巴黎、摩纳哥和尼斯。
上映日期是2027年6月25日。
主演并制作该片的玛戈特·罗比表示："在丹尼·奥申踏入拉斯维加斯之前，两位智谋者教会了他所有的一切：他的父母。",
据悉，演员阵容包括瓦格纳·莫拉、莫妮卡·巴巴拉、维基·克里普斯、乔治·麦凯和奥马尔·西。
detailEn: Classic F1 turns Port of Nice into street circuit for Bradley Cooper's "Ocean's" Prequel
Footage shows vintage racers tackling a hay bale-lined track beside the water
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Classic Formula 1 cars are racing around the Port of Nice, and the footage doing the rounds on Instagram is the clearest look yet at how Bradley Cooper's Ocean's prequel plans to put motorsport on screen once again. As you can see, the working harbour has been transformed into an early-1960s European road course. If you wanted proof that this film is treating its racing seriously, this is it.

The footage begins with a Nissan GT-R camera vehicle fitted with a crane, positioned ahead of several vintage open-wheel racers driving parallel to the water. Temporary structures for production and protective barriers are positioned along both sides of the track. The lead car is dark red with a white stripe, with something like a Brabham F1 car glued to its tail with a number of others following.

As the pack moves on, the camera pans right across the harbour furniture. The port authority building, with its "Service Plaisance Yachting" signage, sits alongside film trailers and crew staging areas. The barriers steering the cars around the area and the cars wear retro branding from the likes of Martini, BP and Shell.
The best moment is the hairpin. The cars squeeze through a tight corner lined with hay bales right at the water's edge, and the red car gets overtaken after the blue car crowds its gearbox.

The project, an untitled prequel to, follows the 1962 Monaco Grand Prix and depicts Danny Ocean's parents taking part in a heist over the race weekend. Bradley Cooper has assumed writing, directing, and acting duties following Lee Isaac Chung's departure in March 2026 due to disagreements over the film's direction. The production includes Paris, Monaco and Nice as locations.
The release date is 25 June, 2027.
Margot Robbie, who stars and produces, said: "Before Danny Ocean ever stepped foot in Vegas, two masterminds taught him everything he knows: his parents."
The cast roster is understood to feature Wagner Moura, Monica Barbaro, Vicky Krieps, George MacKay, and Omar Sy.

items.summaryZh: 前车队经理克里斯蒂安·霍纳在离开红牛车队一年多后，首次透露了自己被解雇的具体情况。他将离职的原因归咎于公司高层。

media.altZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳将红牛车队统治结束的痛苦归咎于迪特里希·马特希茨的去世 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Christian Horner blames Dietrich Mateschitz’s death for the “painful” end of his F1 reign
detailZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳将迪特里希·马特希奇去世归咎于他F1统治时期的“痛苦”结束
克里斯蒂安·霍纳打破沉默，就他‘残酷’的雷诺解雇事件发表评论，将责任归咎于迪特里希·马特希奇去世后的公司转变
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说，关注红牛车队，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的比赛分析
在2025年7月突然且极具争议地离开红牛车队维修区一年多后，前车队经理克里斯蒂安·霍纳终于透露了他被解雇的确切情况。
在《卫报》的一次采访中，这位52岁的执行官揭穿了赛车场的谣言，并将自己离职的原因明确归咎于2022年底红牛亿万富翁创始人迪特里希·马特希奇去世后公司权力的大幅转移。
尽管霍纳曾带领红牛在两个不同的F1统治时代取得成功——首先是与塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔合作，然后是与马克斯·维斯塔潘合作——并赢得了六个车队冠军和八个车手冠军，但他声称新的奥地利领导团队没有提供具体的理由就将他解雇。
“我认为是因为我觉得自己手中的控制权太大，”霍纳在接受《卫报》采访时被问及为何他的20年任期突然结束时说。“但并没有真正给我一个理由。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，丹尼尔·里卡多，红牛车队，车队主管克里斯蒂安·霍纳。
霍纳明确否认了关于他与马克斯·维斯塔潘或他直言不讳的父亲约斯内部摩擦直接导致他被解雇的谣言。
"不，这是红牛的决定，" 霍纳澄清说。"迪特里希去世后，领导层发生了变化。
霍纳被解雇的时间在个人层面上造成了极其痛苦的打击。就在红牛高管向他展示大门的前几天，霍纳的前伴侣、他女儿奥利维亚的母亲贝弗利·艾伦在与眼癌的斗争中去世。
鉴于他个人的哀悼过程以及他投入大量基础工作建立红牛动力系统部门的事实，霍纳承认他解雇的冷酷性质非常难以消化。
“以那样的方式结束，感觉特别残酷和悲伤，”霍纳坦白道。“这很痛苦。非常痛苦。我直到一个月后才真正处理这件事，因为在最初的混乱中，我专注于支持我的女儿度过那段糟糕的时期。”
霍纳对由奥利弗·明茨拉夫和他在维修区的替代者劳伦特·梅基斯领导的当前红牛车队进行了含沙射影的批评，他认为忠诚和优雅正在现代一级方程式赛场上迅速消失。
“历史总是重演。并不是所有车队都以这种方式行事，”霍纳尖锐地指出。“很多车队多年来都没有交付，但你不会看到我离开时那样的残酷。我们在上一场比赛中获得了杆位。”
虽然霍纳承认失去他从400人初创公司打造成为2200人巨头的车队给他带来了巨大的情感打击，但他坚持认为，他在赛道外最终找到了一种平静感。
他确认他已经与Mintzlaff重新建立了一个“合理的关系”，Mintzlaff最近打电话感谢他为车队在巴林取得首个完全独立引擎胜利奠定了基础。此外，霍纳透露，远离一级方程式的无休止的政治战争提供了一种意想不到的、尽管是被迫的、精神上的休息。
霍纳承认，过去两年相当艰难，但那是一个特别敏感的时期。‘我有一个11岁的孩子正在为她去世的母亲哀悼。没有什么比这更重要。’霍纳在谈到他的离职时说。
detailEn: Christian Horner blames Dietrich Mateschitz’s death for the “painful” end of his F1 reign
Christian Horner breaks his silence on his "brutal" Red Bull sacking, blaming a corporate shift after Dietrich Mateschitz's death
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

More than a year after his abrupt and highly controversial exit from the Red Bull Racing pitwall in July 2025, former team principal Christian Horner is finally shedding light on the exact circumstances surrounding his dismissal.

In an interview with The Guardian, the 52-year-old executive stripped away the paddock rumours and placed the blame for his exit squarely on a massive corporate power shift following the passing of Red Bull's billionaire founder, Dietrich Mateschitz, in late 2022.

Despite guiding Red Bull through two separate eras of intense Formula 1 dominance - first with Sebastian Vettel and then with Max Verstappen - and collecting six constructors' championships and eight drivers' titles, Horner claims the new Austrian leadership group ousted him without providing a concrete justification.
"I think it was a feeling there was too much control in my hands," Horner told The Guardian when pressed on why his 20-year tenure was suddenly terminated. "But I wasn't really given a reason."
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Daniel Ricciardo, Red Bull Racing, Team Principal Christian Horner
Horner explicitly denied rumours that internal friction with Max Verstappen or his outspoken father, Jos, directly led to his firing.
"No, it was a Red Bull decision," Horner clarified. "After Dietrich died, things changed in the leadership."

The timing of Horner's dismissal was extraordinarily traumatic on a personal level. Just days before Red Bull executives showed him the door, Horner's former partner and the mother of his daughter Olivia, Beverley Allen, passed away following a battle with eye cancer.

Given his personal grieving process and the sheer amount of foundational work he had poured into establishing the Red Bull Powertrains division, Horner admitted the clinical nature of his firing was incredibly difficult to digest.

"It felt particularly brutal and sad to finish in that manner," Horner confessed. "It was painful. Very painful. I didn't really process it till a month later because, in the immediate aftermath, I focused on supporting my daughter through a hideous period."

Taking a thinly veiled shot at the current Red Bull regime spearheaded by Oliver Mintzlaff and his paddock replacement, Laurent Mekies, Horner suggested that loyalty and grace are rapidly vanishing from the modern Formula 1 landscape.

"History repeats itself. Not all teams act in that way," Horner stated pointedly. "A lot of teams haven't delivered over the years, but you don't see the same brutality as when I left. We had pole position at the previous race."

While Horner acknowledged the severe emotional toll of losing the team he built from a 400-person startup into a 2,200-person juggernaut, he insisted he has eventually found a sense of peace outside the paddock.

He confirmed that he has re-established a "reasonable relationship" with Mintzlaff, who recently called to thank him for laying the groundwork for the team's first fully independent engine victory in Bahrain. Furthermore, Horner revealed that stepping away from the relentless political warfare of Formula 1 provided an unexpected, albeit forced, mental reprieve.

"The last two years had been pretty tough, but it was a particularly sensitive time," Horner admitted regarding his departure. "I had an 11-year-old child grieving her mother. Nothing was more important than that."

items.originalTitle: F1 to return to Africa with new race in Rwanda
detailZh: 一级方程式赛车将在2030年代重返非洲，在卢旺达举办一场新的赛事。
这份为期10年的协议将在下一个十年“早期”开始，但F1和国际汽联尚未指定具体时间。
将在卢旺达首都基加利以南大约40公里的布古塞拉建设一个全新的赛道，首场比赛日期和开发里程碑将在“适当的时候”公布。
这将是一级方程式赛车自1993年以来首次在非洲举办赛事，当时在基兰米的最后一场南非大奖赛举行。
F1已经尝试了好几年重返大陆，基亚拉米一直被认为是回归的热门候选地。
但一个可行的交易从未达成，尽管有时看起来很接近，甚至在去年初，基亚拉米还希望继续进行赛道改造，以实现所需的FIA一级赛事资格，前提是成功回归F1赛历。
与此同时，与卢旺达官员的谈判进展得更顺利，F1将其描述为获得了“正确的基石，与最佳合作伙伴”以举办可持续的大奖赛。
七次世界冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿一直是增加非洲赛事到赛程的倡导者，甚至建议他可能会推迟退休以参加这样的大奖赛。
然而，由于卢旺达的参赛入口点在2030年代初尚不明确，现在41岁的汉密尔顿仍然参加比赛的可能性似乎非常低，而卡亚马事件可能可以在更短的时间内增加。
近年来，卢旺达通过举办各种比赛和通过赞助提升其国际赛事和体育项目组合，例如与顶级足球队合作，扩大了其国际赛事和体育项目组合。
大赦国际将“访问卢旺达”活动称为“体育洗白”努力，旨在“转移对其糟糕的人权记录的注意力”，但一级方程式表示，新的大奖赛旨在通过支持旅游业、吸引投资、培养当地人才和为社区和企业创造新的机会来建立一项遗产。
卢旺达共和国总统保罗·卡加梅在宣布中表示，“今天属于非洲”。
“三十多年来，世界顶级赛车运动锦标赛一直未在这个大陆上比赛，而这份协议改变了这一切，”他说。
国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏莱姆，他在2024年将组织年度颁奖典礼首次带到非洲，在基加利举办时，称之为一级方程式赛车在全球持续增长中的“一个重要步骤”，而一级方程式赛车首席执行官斯蒂法诺·多梅尼卡利表示这是一个“里程碑时刻”。
多梅尼卡利说：“非洲一直是一级方程式赛车未来的组成部分，从一开始我们就决心以正确的方式、与正确的合作伙伴、长期承诺以及明确的愿景回归，以产生有意义的影響。”
detailEn: Formula 1 will return to Africa in the 2030s with a new race in Rwanda.
The 10-year agreement will begin “early” in the next decade but F1 and the FIA have not specified when.

A new purpose-built circuit will be built in Bugusera, around 40 kilometres south of the Rwandan capital Kigali, with details such as the first race date and development milestones to be announced “in due course”.
It will be F1’s first race in Africa since 1993, when the last South African GP at Kyalami was held.
F1 has been trying to pull off a return to the continent for several years with Kyalami repeatedly in the frame for a return.

But a viable deal was never concluded, even though it seemed to be close at times and as recently as early last year Kyalami hoped to push on with circuit modifications to achieve the required FIA Grade 1 status pending successfully returning to the F1 calendar.
At the same time, negotiations with Rwanda officials progressed more successfully and F1 has described it as achieving “the right foundations, with the best partner” for a sustainable grand prix.

Seven-time world champion Lewis Hamilton has long been an advocate for an African race being added to the schedule and even suggested he would delay his retirement to be able to take part in such a grand prix.

However, with Rwanda having an unknown entry point vaguely in the early 2030s, it seems highly unlikely that Hamilton - now 41 - will still be racing, whereas a Kyalami event could have been added in a shorter timeframe.
Rwanda has expanded its international events and sports portfolio in recent years by hosting various competitions and building its profile with sponsorship, for example with top-level football teams.

The Visit Rwanda campaign has been called a sportswashing effort “to deflect attention from its terrible human rights record” by Amnesty International, but F1 says the new grand prix aims to establish “a legacy by supporting tourism, attracting investment, developing local talent and creating new opportunities for communities and businesses".
Paul Kagame, president of the Republic of Rwanda, said as part of the announcement that “today belongs to Africa”.
“For more than three decades, the world's premier motorsport championship has raced without this continent, and that changes with this agreement,” he said.

FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem, who took his organisation’s annual awards ceremony to Africa for the first time when it was hosted in Kigali in 2024, called it a “an important step in the continued global growth of motorsport” for F1 while F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali said it was a “landmark moment”.

“Africa has always been part of Formula 1's future, and from the beginning we were determined to return in the right way, with the right partner, a long-term commitment and a clear vision for creating meaningful impact,” Domenicali said.
keyPointsZh: 这是F1自1993年南非GP以来首次在非洲举办赛事
